articles.title: From SpaceX to Anthropic, 2026 Looks Like a Big Year for IPOs
articles.mainIdea: From SpaceX to Anthropic, 2026 Looks Like a Big Year for IPOs
articles.summary: Barrons.com: From SpaceX to Anthropic, 2026 Looks Like a Big Year for IPOs. A pack of large private start-ups hungry for capital look ready to try a newly revived initial-public-offering market. SpaceX could be the largest, but AI companies could dominate the year. Related tickers mentioned: AMD, ANTH.PVT, BLSFF, BLSFY, JPM, WBD, ^GSPC.

articles.title: Review & Preview: Lackluster Jobs, Lively Market
articles.mainIdea: Review & Preview: Lackluster Jobs, Lively Market
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Review & Preview: Lackluster Jobs, Lively Market. Wall Street cheered a lower unemployment rate, even though the December jobs figure missed expectations. The Nasdaq Composite rallied 0.8%. At 4.4%, the unemployment rate still came in below the expected 4.5%, and November’s figure was revised lower to 4.5%. Related tickers mentioned: META, OKLO, VST, ^GSPC, ^IXIC.

articles.title: Bank Earnings, Inflation Data: What to Watch Next Week
articles.mainIdea: Bank Earnings, Inflation Data: What to Watch Next Week
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Bank Earnings, Inflation Data: What to Watch Next Week. Next week will be busy as 2026 launches into full swing. Key economic data are due, including the consumer-price index for December and producer-price index for November. Meanwhile, the nation’s largest banks are scheduled to report earnings, starting with JPMorgan Chase Tuesday. Related tickers mentioned: DAL, TSM.
